title: Goal control event envelope
description: Role/thread-bound, ordered, CAS-bound task event. Semantic role/state authorization is enforced by the FSM in addition to this shape validation.

event_id.description: Globally unique opaque event identifier. UUIDs are recommended, while stable readable control IDs are allowed. Reusing an ID with different bytes is always rejected.

type.description: FSM event name. The runtime keeps the authoritative event-to-role and event-to-state matrix.

payload.description: Event-specific data. It must not contain credentials, raw profile data, or PII.
